attr.title: Plants Vs Zombies Portable
attr.desc: A fan-made port of the classic tower defense game. You must place plants to defend your house from invading zombies. Requires original game assets from Plants vs. Zombies GOTY edition.
attr.desc_md:
**Features:**
- Full controller support: virtual cursor with tile snapping, hold R2/L3 to move faster
- In-game controller settings (cursor speed, sun-collect range, free cursor)
- Adventure mode, Zen Garden, and the minigames

Fan port (original game by PopCap/EA)

Engine: [PvZ-Portable](https://github.com/wszqkzqk/PvZ-Portable) by wszqkzqk

PortMaster packaging and the memory-mapped pak / stb_image work build on [PvZ-PortMaster](https://github.com/nullptr97j/PvZ-PortMaster) by gama97

This build: https://github.com/jenny92-tech/PvZ-Portable
attr.inst: Provide the main.pak file and properties/ folder from a legal copy of Plants vs. Zombies GOTY into the pvz_portable folder.
